roughCut.title: Rough cut
roughCut.cap: This film is longer than 10 minutes, so the rough cut stops there.
export.title: Export film
export.captionsNote: The captions are saved beside the film as well, either way.
export.waits: Scene {n} waits for a click. With no one to click, the film goes on 5 seconds after its last action.
export.refused: This film can be shown in school, but it can't be exported to share outside it:
export.done: {name} is saved, with its captions beside it.
export.capped: The film is longer than 10 minutes, so it stops there.
export.unsaved: {name} is made, but not saved yet.
roughCut.missingModels: Scene {n} uses {names}, which this device can't find, so it shows as an outline. Choose it again in Backstage.
roughCut.missingBackdrop: Scene {n}'s backdrop isn't all here, so it shows plain ground and sky. Choose it again in Backstage.
